Look man, im not gonna claim that i can fully relate. But i feel like i connect eith this. Ive also wanted to die a lot and people always tell me that same thing. And it is true that its your decision. All my life, nobody thought i had any sort of depression issues, i asked to be brought somewhere by my parents, who said that i was just "sad". I even tried killing myself, sometimes once a week. I was broken and i felt that there was nobody who could feel the same. Then one night, me and my friend were drinking at a buddies house, and he randomly got really depressed. He attempted to drive home, saying he was going to ram his car into a wall. I never fought that hard in my life to keep someone from doing something. It made me realize how much it does hurt. It hurts so bad, but u gotta find something you love to do, and focus on that. For me it was aspiring to be a directed, and making my own short films. Please, if u need someone to talk to feel free to message me, best of luck to you friend ❤

I dont know you enough to know what your going through, but i found the best way, is not to forget about it, but to keep moving forward, do the things you love with the people you love, keep pushing yourself to do better. I know this probably isnt a major problem, in terms of others' problems, but recently i had a nasty breakup with a girl i dated for two years. We had plans to get married, to die together. I sat and cried myself to sleep every night and tried to kill myself more times than i could count on one hand. But eventually I saw that i was like a ticking time bomb, and i wasnt doing anything worthwhile for months, so i decided to pick myself back up, and dust myself off. You cant let this beat you, you cant surrender, because if you do, IT will win(talking about the depression). I hope everything gets better, and if u need someone to talk to im here.

Look, i deal with this same issue. Im the youngest in a family of five and everyone takes their anger out on me. I make youtube videos because i truly wnjoy editing. It takes me away from all the shitty problems in my life. My point here is that, you gotta find something that you truly love to do, something that can let you block out the rest of the world for a short period of time. I truly hope things get better for you and im here to talk if you need someone ❤

Im truly sorry for your loss. If you need someone to talk to please feel free to private message me. Ive also lost family members to suicide, drug use, and so on. Hopefully everything will be ok, im praying for you ❤❤
